description: List published GHCR or Docker Hub tags for a local-ydb container image, with numeric version tags sorted newest first. Use before local_ydb_upgrade_version; registry pagination and authentication are restricted to trusted origins, and pageSize and maxPages bound pagination.

image.description: GHCR or Docker Hub container image name to inspect. Defaults to ghcr.io/ydb-platform/local-ydb.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of registry pages to fetch before truncating the result. Defaults to 10.

pageSize.description: Requested tags per registry page. Defaults to 100.

name: local_ydb_list_versions
